verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Oneleet monitors AWS, GitHub and Google Workspace configuration, and that findings can be triaged, assigned and resolved in the platform. Nothing documents control-failure or drift alerts being delivered to Slack, email or a ticketing system, or what context such alerts would carry. The status-page email subscription covers Oneleet's own service incidents, not customer control failures, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding
